title: Document it
summary: Generates or repairs a managed DocInsight comment on the single symbol represented by a Structure-tree node
intro: Read this when one declaration needs a doc comment and you do not want to touch the rest of the unit. Right-click the symbol in the Structure form and choose Document it to generate or repair its managed DocInsight comment.

surfaces.caption: Document it
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Document it; its managed DocInsight comment is generated or repaired

surfaces.usage: drag-lint document --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> [--apply|--json|--no-backup|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH] - generate/repair a managed DocInsight comment

questions.ask: How do I add or repair a doc comment on just one declaration?
What does the managed block say about where a property or field is used?
questions.command: drag-lint document --qname <Unit.TFoo.Prop> --apply   (writes Used in: Routine (file.pas) [r|w|rw] in place of Used by:)
